mitigation.declaredCompositionDelta: The five task images are delivered from digest-pinned GHCR mirrors instead of the anonymous public.ecr.aws pull that refused all five. Nothing else changes: the corpus pin, the task sources, the harness, each task's Dockerfile, the candidate pin (best-agent main 5bc13e8b / 0.0.14-beta.1), the provider (glm-5.3 at reasoning effort high through dim-oauth), fh_agent_timeout_multiplier=1, every cell's own official budget, and fh_max_parallel=3 (the source run's own generation parallelism) are exactly what run 39557190033 declared. Each task's Dockerfile keeps its pinned `FROM public.ecr.aws/...` bytes because the mirror is aliased to that reference locally, so the frozen per-task record's task.dockerImage stays the reference the Dockerfile actually uses.
mitigation.whyMirrorRatherThanAuthenticatedPull: An authenticated public.ecr.aws pull would need an AWS principal and long-lived access keys as new repository secrets in this public repository, and it only moves the quota to that account. The GHCR mirror needs no external credential (it uses this repository's own GITHUB_TOKEN) and its identity is checkable by digest rather than by trusting the transport.
mitigation.mirrorAvailabilityCheck: Reproduced by this operator on 2026-10-21 before the freeze: `docker manifest inspect` resolved all five digest-pinned refs anonymously from GHCR (5 of 5 present), so no dispatch is spent on a mirror that no longer exists. The Generate job still re-proves it in-run.
mitigation.inJobGuard: The Generate job pulls each declared mirror, aliases it to the pinned reference, blackholes the source registry host in /etc/hosts, and refuses to continue unless a probe build proves the pinned reference resolves from the local alias. A plumbing failure therefore fails that job before the harness runs and cannot consume an attempt.
mitigation.notAConditionThatMakesTheCellPassable: The change touches only how the frozen image bytes reach the runner. It does not alter image contents (digest-identical), any task instruction, the workspace, the tool surface, the model, the effort, the budgets or the grader, so it cannot make a task easier or a verdict gentler.

dispatchInputs.whyOneDispatch: The plan job refuses a run that predeclares more than 10 tasks (`Each workflow run must preselect between 1 and 10 tasks.`), and this set is five cells, so a single dispatch covers it without splitting.
dispatchInputs.whyExplicitTaskIds: `fh_tasks` is used instead of offset/limit because these five cells are scattered through corpus order, which also holds the 18 cells that already passed and the 7 that are graded failed; an offset/limit selection would re-run cells this manifest does not admit. `fh_tasks` is validated against the frozen corpus and the GPU exclusion before any job starts.
dispatchInputs.whyParallelThree: fh_max_parallel=3 is the source run's own generation parallelism, kept identical so the only declared delta stays the image transport.
dispatchInputs.whyNoSeparateSmoke: The candidate commit 5bc13e8b was already smoke-gated on this corpus (run 39555372358) and full-run (39557190033) under this exact provider profile; this batch rebuilds the same commit and its fh-candidate job must pass the same delivery gate before any Generate job can start, so a second smoke would measure the same plumbing, not a new candidate.

expectedJobs: 3 freeze jobs (candidate, corpus, plan) + 5 Generate jobs + 1 Aggregate = 9; the two mirror jobs stay inert because fh_mirror_image is empty (the mirrors already exist). Generation parallelism 3, so the batch runs in two waves; expected wall clock about 2-3 hours because four of the five cells have a 5400 s official budget.

knownRisks.providerTransport: A transport death would leave a cell without a clean verdict, as it already did for one attempt of the katex cell and for several cells of earlier runs.
knownRisks.credentialExpiry: The dim OAuth JWT in CI carries exp 2026-10-26T06:20:08Z; provider materialization happens at the start of every Generate job and refuses an expired token, so an expiry would surface as a pre-model failure with no verdict.
knownRisks.mirrorPull: The Generate job's own guard makes a mirror or alias failure fail closed before the harness runs, so no attempt is consumed by a plumbing failure.
knownRisks.budget: Each cell keeps the official budget the source run declared (5400 s for these five); none is extended.
knownRisks.finality: One attempt per cell in this manifest. A cell that dies again keeps no verdict and this manifest makes no second dispatch for it.
